headline: Kazakhstan and Iraq Request Higher OPEC+ Production Capacity Ratings
summary: Kazakhstan and Iraq have asked OPEC+ to increase their estimated crude production capacity ahead of the group's 2027 policy meeting. This review marks the first time OPEC will assess sustainable production levels for its members.
why: OPEC+ production capacity ratings determine individual member output quotas, which directly influence global oil supply and price dynamics.
why_moved: Market participants monitor OPEC+ capacity reviews as they signal potential future supply adjustments that impact global oil prices.
